author: Jonathan Formella
text: We need more businesses like Septic Tank Man nowadays!  Their office and dispatch was great in scheduling my appointment and it got even better when their technician Cam came out.  He provided an honest assessment of my tank and educated me on how the system works. A great guy who knows his stuff and has great integrity.  My tank was not even close to being full, his honestly saved me a bunch of money.  If you have a septic tank and live in Venice, Sarasota, Englewood, North Port or Port Charlotte- you have to call Septic Tank Man!!!  Thanks again guys!

author: David Turner
text: I needed our septic tanks pumped and inspected. I called Septic Tank Man, they immediately answered the phone  and were able to send out a truck the next day. TJ and Cam called 15 minutes before they arrived. They were both professional, friendly and knowledgeable. Tanks were pumped and they gave me a a good overview of my our system. Overall I highly recommend Septic Tank Man.

author: Sue Gottesman
text: TJ came out yesterday.  I wanted to understand the process and he was awesome at explaining how he does what he does so proficiently.  The process was quick and clean and TJ was very friendly and professional.  We made the right choice for STM to install our new tank 5 years ago and then to service it.

author: Matthew Mativi
text: Big THANK YOU to Septic Tank Man for always taking great care of us. TJ came out today for a pump and after looking at it determined we didn’t need one. Our filters were plugged and he serviced/cleaned them and did a great job. And saved us money too. Thank you for a job well done and your honesty. Thanks again to the team and thanks for taking care of us…y'all are the best!

author: Becca Anastasi
text: Huge thanks to TJ at Septic Tank Man for the prompt and professional service today. He was super knowledgeable, friendly, and left everything exactly how he found it. Exceptional service from start to finish. Highly recommend!
